description: HAL-built HS 748 H1526 (first flight 17 Feb 1976, delivered IAF March 1976 as multi-engine trainer), installed on the main-gate traffic circle of IIT Patna, Bihta, by April 2023, erected without engines or nose cone (mock-ups later fitted), painted grey. Source warbirds.in (Jan 2024), bharat-rakshak.
